entities.name: PMID:25079457
observations: 2014 human case-control study titled “Serum interleukin-22 (IL-22) is increased in the early stage of Hashimoto's thyroiditis compared to non-autoimmune thyroid disease and healthy controls.”

entities.name: IL-22
observations: Serum IL-22 measured by Quantikine ELISA was 42±34 pg/mL in 55 newly diagnosed, euthyroid, untreated Hashimoto thyroiditis patients, versus 18±15 pg/mL in 30 nodular-goiter patients without HT (P<0.001) and 20±13 pg/mL in age-/sex-matched healthy controls (P=0.014); nodular-goiter and healthy groups did not differ (P=0.496).

entities.name: Hashimoto thyroiditis
observations: The study's early-stage group was newly diagnosed, euthyroid, and untreated; the abstract provides no time-from-onset threshold or additional formal early-stage criteria.
